title: Variant compatibility audit: tokenizer, context, and tooling parity for fallback routing
creator: Lena Park
description: Audit and remediate the fallback model variant compatibility matrix used by smart routing. Focus areas: tokenizer parity (byte-pair / sentencepiece differences), effective context length and truncation rules, function/tool-calling capability, structured output / JSON schema support, and SDK/console flags that influence compatibility. Goal is to ensure automated routing fallbacks do not introduce silent tokenization or tooling regressions for customers when primary variants are unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Master compatibility matrix updated with current model variants, tokenizer id, tokenizer version, max context tokens, tool-calling support, and known edge cases.
Automated validation tests added to CI that run tokenization parity checks for a representative prompt set across each fallback pair.
Routing policy generator uses the matrix to mark unsafe fallback transitions and exposes warnings in Console and API responses when a fallback may change tokenization/semantics.
Release notes and internal playbook updated with rollback and mitigation steps for detected parity regressions.
One canary rollout performed for routing changes with telemetry dashboards showing tokenization mismatch rate < 0.1% before promoting to all traffic.
steps: Run the audit script (scripts/compat_audit/scan_variants.py) against production model catalog to produce current matrix snapshot (output: /tmp/compat-snapshot-2026-03-01.json).
Identify high-risk fallback pairs (different tokenizer families or context < 2x margin) and create sub-issues for remediation.
Add unit/CI tests: tokenization parity harness (tests/compat/test_token_parity.py) and a tooling-support matrix test (tests/compat/test_tooling_support.py).
Open PR to update compatibility table (runtime repo) and to add runtime guards that refuse unsafe fallbacks unless explicitly forced.
Coordinate with Console team to add a visual flag and warning for routes that have non-parity fallbacks (Console ticket PM-4122).
Canary the change on dedicated staging account, validate telemetry, then roll to hosted with feature flag window for 48 hours.
